commands.name: boot
argv: ( python3 -I -S -B -c 'import json;from pathlib import Path;print('"'"'PIX_CLEAN_BOOT='"'"'+json.dumps({'"'"'boot_id'"'"':Path('"'"'/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id'"'"').read_text().strip(),'"'"'os_release'"'"':Path('"'"'/etc/os-release'"'"').read_text(),'"'"'interfaces'"'"':sorted(p.name for p in Path('"'"'/sys/class/net'"'"').iterdir())}))' ); pxrc=$?; printf "PIX_LOADER_BOOT_RC:%s\n" "$pxrc"

( printf '===services===

commands.name: 025-session
argv: ( test -f /var/run/cloud_oauth/session.json && echo session-ready; tail -10 /var/run/cloud_oauth/session.log 2>/dev/null; true ); pxrc=$?; printf "PIX_LOADER_025_SESSION_RC:%s\n" "$pxrc"

commands.name: 070-cleanup-diagnosis
argv: ( cat /storage/qa614/observer-result.json; systemctl show qa614-observer -p ActiveState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus; journalctl -u qa614-observer --no-pager -n 15; mount | grep qa614; true ); pxrc=$?; printf "PIX_LOADER_070_CLEANUP_DIAGNOSIS_RC:%s\n" "$pxrc"
